One line per batch. A batch is what ONE `pip-agents:reviewer-rules` agent audits: at most 30 rules (`tools/batching.py`), as the line spans listed (`Read(file, offset=<a>, limit=<b>-<a>+1)` for each span, 1-based like INDEX.md), and exactly the rule ids in parentheses. Each span starts on a heading and ends on the line before the next heading. A batch always carries the doctrine's preamble and Allowed Exceptions spans.
